WandB
Approach: Decorator (Weave)
Key Strength: Rich experiment tracking
Scale: 1B calls/month, 50M traces/day

LangSmith
Approach: Callback hooks
Key Strength: Deep LangChain integration, A/B playground
Scale: 100M traces/day

Arize AI
Approach: Inference logging
Key Strength: Embedding drift detection
Scale: 5B inferences/month

Approach: API proxy
Key Strength: Zero code change, Cost tracking
Scale: 300 req/s peak, 100M req/month
